summaries.title: TeCH: Text-guided Reconstruction of Lifelike Clothed Humans

Question Answering (VQA), Text-to-Image diffusion
model (T2I), Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：To represent high-resolution 3D clothed humans at an affordable cost, we propose a hybrid 3D representation based on DMTet, which consists of an explicit body shape grid and...。

summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that TeCH outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in terms of reconstruction accuracy and rendering quality）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 35 赞），本工作为突破 **合成数据与精细化配比 (Data Curation)、图像扩散与流匹配生成 (Diffusion & Flow)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Teach LLMs to Personalize -- An Approach inspired by Writing Education

summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our results show significant improvements over a variety of baselines）。
